outline:
就主要的染料和顏料之化學結構、製造方式和基本化性予以闡述，以便對色料的相關應用有較為明晰的瞭解。
Chemical structure, manufacturing and properties of main dyes and pigments are studied. Further applications of the colourstuff are explained.
